en.title: Longest Palindrome of at Least Two Characters with Lexicographic Tie-Break
en.description:
The string contains only uppercase English letters. Find the longest contiguous palindromic substring of length at least 2; if there are several longest results, output the lexicographically smallest string; if none exists, output None.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: One line containing a string of uppercase letters. The original gave no length bound; this site adds 1≤length≤1000.
en.output: Output the chosen palindrome string or None.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: ABCCBA; None; AA. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Enumerate both odd and even palindrome centers, expand each until it can no longer continue, and compare only the longest candidate at each center.
